propositions: Every typed field in _config_schema.py must have at least one attribute-read site outside schema/config plumbing modules, else CI gate fires.
AST-level check matches terminal attribute names in Load context across all read shapes (config.section.field, local bindings, self.config.section.field, getattr-invisible).
Fields with zero read sites and no '# read-via: <pointer>' comment cause gate failure; bare read-via markers are rejected.
read-via escape hatch requires a pointer or reason for indirect reads (getattr dispatch, client-only knobs); markers without justification fail validation.
Terminal-name matching is permissive to avoid false positives but accepts fail-quiet collisions (same-named fields across sections, shadowed unrelated attributes do not fire).
